key_assumptions: Bear: USD 0.50 normalized forward EPS at 12x as component constraints, tariffs, promotions or weak discretionary demand reverse margin progress and working-capital cash conversion fades. Base: USD 0.75 normalized forward EPS at 15x as unchanged guidance converts, peripherals offset component softness, improved margin persists and dilution is contained. Bull: USD 1.00 normalized forward EPS at 18x as premium ecosystem growth broadens, acquired brands execute, component supply normalizes and mix plus cost discipline lift cash earnings. All cases normalize management's USD 0.58-0.74 2026 non-GAAP EPS guidance for stock compensation, amortization, product-cycle sensitivity, working capital, net debt and 2027 operating outcomes.
evidence_summary: The SEC 10-Q and SEC-filed results release establish Q1 revenue decline, gross-margin expansion, positive GAAP operating income and operating cash flow, near-zero net debt, lower inventory, repurchases, segment divergence, Q2 outlook and unchanged full-year guidance. The canonical market packet establishes a 27.90% 20-session rise and close above the upper Bollinger band without anomalous volume. No newer primary filing verifies a commensurate improvement in intrinsic value.
soft_gaps: Q2 2026 results were not yet filed; full-year guidance is non-GAAP and sensitive to product mix, stock compensation, amortization, semiconductor pricing and tariffs; normalized forward EPS and terminal multiple remain cycle-sensitive; no accepted canonical idea-security relationship exists.
invalidation_summary: Invalidate if peripherals growth no longer offsets component weakness, gross margin reverts without a temporary cause, adjusted earnings fail to convert to GAAP and free cash flow, inventory rebuilds ahead of demand, acquired brands consume capital without returns, or dilution overwhelms repurchases and per-share growth.
